senses.gloss:
गञ्ज mfn. subst. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) A mine, a jewel mine mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं)
 1. A cow-
house or station of cowherds.
 2. A treasury, a jewel room, the
place where plate, &c. is preserved.
 3. A mart, a place where
grain, &c. is stored for sale.
 m. (-ञ्जः) Disrespect, contempt.
 f. (ञ्जा)
1. A tavern.
 2. A drinking vessel.
 3. A hut, a hovel, the abode of
low people.
 4. The Gunja or Ratti, (Abrus precatorious:) see गुञ्जा.
E. गजि to sound, अच् affix; fem. affix टाप्.

गञ्चिका f. (-का) A tavern.
 E. कन् added to the preceding.
